findings.message: Version tag "3.1" moved to zeebe:versionTag.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:versionTag

findings.message: Camunda 8 has no per-process history time to live (was "180").
findings.suggestion: Configure data retention for the cluster (Operate, Tasklist and Optimize archiving).

findings.message: Execution listener on "start" (class "com.acme.orders.AuditListener") runs Java or script code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement it as a job worker and declare it with zeebe:executionListeners (eventType="start", type="<job type>").

findings.message: Camunda 8 does not record the starting user in a variable.
findings.suggestion: Pass the user as a variable when creating the instance.

findings.message: Implemented as a Camunda user task (zeebe:userTask).
findings.suggestion: zeebe:userTask

findings.message: assignee became zeebe:assignmentDefinition assignee="=starter".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:assignmentDefinition

findings.message: candidateGroups became zeebe:assignmentDefinition candidateGroups="sales,management".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:assignmentDefinition

findings.message: dueDate became zeebe:taskSchedule dueDate="=reviewDueDate".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskSchedule — the value must be an ISO 8601 date-time.

findings.message: Priority 80 became zeebe:priorityDefinition.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:priorityDefinition

findings.message: Camunda Form "review-order" linked with zeebe:formDefinition formId.
findings.suggestion: Deploy the .form file with the process; Camunda 7 and 8 share the form-js schema.

findings.message: Task listener on "create" (class "com.acme.orders.NotifyReviewer") runs code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement it as a job worker and declare it with zeebe:taskListeners (eventType="creating").

findings.message: Dropped: Camunda 8 has no asynchronous continuations. The engine commits after every step and every job-based task is already a wait state, so there is no transaction boundary to place and no job executor job to prioritise.
findings.suggestion: Nothing to model. A failure no longer rolls back to the last async boundary: a job failure retries the job, and an expression failure raises an incident on the element.

findings.message: External task topic "charge-payment" became job type "charge-payment".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskDefinition type — point the external task worker at the Camunda 8 job API with the same type.

findings.message: 3 input/output parameters moved to zeebe:ioMapping, JUEL translated to FEEL.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:ioMapping

findings.message: Retry count 5 moved to zeebe:taskDefinition retries.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskDefinition retries

findings.message: The retry interval (PT5M) is not part of the Camunda 8 model.
findings.suggestion: Pass it as the retry back-off when the worker fails the job (fail-job retryBackOff).

findings.message: Camunda 7 correlates message "PaymentConfirmed" by API call (business key, process variables or instance id); the model names no key, and Camunda 8 requires one.
findings.suggestion: Add <zeebe:subscription correlationKey="=…"/> to message "Message_PaymentConfirmed", naming the variable publishers correlate on.

findings.message: Decision "shipping-cost" → zeebe:calledDecision, result in "shippingCost".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:calledDecision

findings.message: Result mapper "singleEntry" matches Camunda 8, which stores a single output value as-is.
findings.suggestion: Nothing to model.

findings.message: Calls "invoice-process" through zeebe:calledElement.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:calledElement

findings.message: Variable passing kept as in Camunda 7: only mapped parent variables in, only mapped child variables out.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:calledElement propagateAllParentVariables / propagateAllChildVariables and zeebe:ioMapping

findings.message: Java delegate class "com.acme.orders.ShipOrderDelegate" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "shipOrderDelegate" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "class" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).

findings.message: Timer expression "${deliveryWindow}" became "=deliveryWindow".
findings.suggestion: FEEL timer expression

findings.message: Script was not converted: groovy scripts do not run in Camunda 8.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite it as a FEEL expression in zeebe:script (expression, resultVariable), or implement it as a job worker with zeebe:taskDefinition.

findings.message: Delegate expression "${notificationService}" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "notificationService" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "delegateExpression" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).

findings.message: Expression "${escalation.raise(execution)}" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "Task_escalate" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "expression" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).

findings.message: Condition "${approved && order.total <= 1000}" became "=approved and order.total <= 1000".
findings.suggestion: FEEL condition

findings.message: Condition "${approved and order.customer.vip eq true}" became "=approved and order.customer.vip = true".
findings.suggestion: FEEL condition

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.10.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.

findings.message: Placeholder correlationKey "="placeholder-Message_PaymentConfirmed"" written so the model deploys (zeebe/message-subscription).
findings.suggestion: Replace it with the real value; the placeholder does nothing useful at runtime.

findings.message: Placeholder jobType "placeholder-Task_summary" written so the model deploys (zeebe/script-task-implementation).
findings.suggestion: Replace it with the real value; the placeholder does nothing useful at runtime.
